description: Returns the stored price history of one product for up to 90 days, in one currency: first_seen, last_seen, the lowest and highest price (also incl. shipping), the number of observations, the number of shops and the source. Prices are stored only when they change. With less than 30 days of data, insufficient_history is true and nothing can be said about earlier prices. It never says whether a discount is real.

country.description: Market, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2: NO, SE, DK, FI, DE, AT, CH, NL, BE, LU, FR, ES, IT, PT, PL, IE, GB, CZ, SK, HU, RO, BG, HR, SI, GR, CY, MT, EE, LV, LT, IS, LI; or ALL (switched-on markets). Unknown codes (e.g. XX) are an error. Not the language: use lang for that.

product_id.description: The product id (or slug) from search_offers or get_product.

name: get_price_history
title: Price history
